_comment: Letterboxd slug -> TMDB film id, for films where the search cannot find the
tools/lib/covers.mjs refuses a match unless every word of the wanted title
appears in the title that came back, which is what stops a loose search
installing a poster for the wrong work. A few films defeat that honestly:
TMDB's English title for them is one almost nobody uses, so the titles
really do disagree and the guard is right to say so.
An id here skips the search for that one film. Add an entry only when you
have opened the TMDB page and confirmed it is the right film.

nausicaa-of-the-valley-of-the-wind.why: TMDB titles this 'Warriors of the Wind', the 1985 edited US release
